info.title: Catering events and equipment API
info.description: Phase 1/2: event planning and equipment catalog. No stock reservations. Mutations require the current resource version; responses return the new version. All access follows the existing global module/permission model. Editing an existing event also requires view permission. Timestamps accept whole seconds only.
